# opencode-cloudbase-auth A [Magpie](https://usemagpie.ai) / [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) **provider plugin** that turns Tencent CloudBase's *Mini Program Growth Plan* (小程序成长计划) free model quota into a regular OpenAI-compatible provider. [中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) ## Why this plugin exists CloudBase's AI gateway restricts the growth-plan quota to the **Mini Program SDK / CloudBase SDK channel** only. Calling the public AI endpoint with an API key fails outright: ``` POST https://{envId}.api.tcloudbasegateway.com/v1/ai/hunyuan-v3/chat/completions → 403 AI_CHANNEL_NOT_ALLOWED 小程序成长计划仅支持小程序 SDK 和云开发 SDK 调用 ``` Only requests that originate from the WeChat Mini Program SDK or the CloudBase SDK can spend that quota. This plugin works together with a small cloud function (`aiProxy`, deployed in the same CloudBase environment) that calls the models through `@cloudbase/node-sdk` — which *is* the allowed channel — and exposes it over CloudBase's HTTP API: ``` Agent → magpie gateway → this plugin → CloudBase HTTP API (cloud function invoke) → @cloudbase/node-sdk (SDK channel, allowed) → hy3 / hy4 / deepseek-v4.1-flash (growth-plan quota) ``` The cloud function's public entry point returns a single JSON body and does **not** support real streaming, so the plugin forces `stream: false` upstream, then synthesizes OpenAI SSE frames for clients that asked for a stream. ## Data flow ![Data flow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Le0nByte/opencode-cloudbase-auth/main/docs/architecture.svg)
Mermaid source (editable) ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph client["Client"] A["Agent
Hermes / Claude Code / Cursor"] end subgraph magpie["magpie gateway 127.0.0.1:3425"] B["route to provider cloudbase"] C["plugin fetch adapter
force non-streaming + synthesize SSE"] end subgraph cb["Tencent CloudBase"] D["HTTP API
/v1/functions/aiProxy"] E["cloud function aiProxy
@cloudbase/node-sdk"] F["CloudBase SDK channel
hy3 / hy4 / deepseek-v4.1-flash"] end A -->|"model: cloudbase/hy3"| B --> C C -->|"stream: false"| D --> E --> F F -->|"deduct growth-plan quota"| E E -->|"full JSON"| C C -->|"SSE frames + [DONE]"| A ```
Editable sources: [`docs/architecture.drawio`](docs/architecture.drawio) (open with [app.diagrams.net](https://app.diagrams.net)). ## Install ```bash # from GitHub magpie plugin add github:Le0nByte/opencode-cloudbase-auth # from npm magpie plugin add opencode-cloudbase-auth # from a local checkout (development) magpie plugin add ./opencode-cloudbase-auth ``` ## Deploy the upstream cloud function Node.js runtime, dependency `@cloudbase/node-sdk >= 3.16`: ```js const tcb = require('@cloudbase/node-sdk') let app exports.main = async (event = {}) => { if (!app) app = tcb.init({ env: process.env.TCB_ENV || 'your-env-id', timeout: 120000 }) const ai = app.ai() const provider = event.provider || 'hunyuan-v3' const model = event.model || 'hy3' const messages = event.messages || [{ role: 'user', content: 'hi' }] const r = await ai.createModel(provider).generateText({ model, messages }) const u = r.usage || {} return { id: 'chatcmpl-' + Date.now(), object: 'chat.completion', created: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000), model, choices: [{ index: 0, message: { role: 'assistant', content: r.text }, finish_reason: 'stop' }], usage: { prompt_tokens: u.prompt_tokens || 0, completion_tokens: u.completion_tokens || 0, total_tokens: u.total_tokens || 0 } } } ``` Deploy it with `tcb fn deploy` (or the console editor), then the public entry point is: ``` https://{envId}.api.tcloudbasegateway.com/v1/functions/aiProxy ``` > Note: paths appended after the function name are ignored by the HTTP API, so the plugin's `/v1` suffix is harmless. ## Sign in Two values are collected at login: | Field | Description | | --- | --- | | CloudBase environment ID | e.g. `cloudbase-xxxxxxxx`, stored as `metadata.envId` | | CloudBase API key | Console → Environment settings → API Key → create. Server-side key, never expires | ```bash magpie plugin login cloudbase magpie provider test cloudbase # should print: ✓ chat · hy3 ``` > The API key is the environment's highest-privilege credential — it bypasses all database access checks. It is stored only in `~/.config/magpie/plugin-auth.json` (mode 600). Never ship it in client code or a public repo. ## Models | Model id | Notes | | --- | --- | | `hy3` | Hunyuan 3, cheapest | | `hy4` | Hunyuan 4 | | `hy4-preview` | Hunyuan 4 preview | | `deepseek-v4.1-flash` | DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, peak/off-peak pricing | | `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` | DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 snapshot | Call them as `cloudbase/hy3` from any agent. ```bash curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/chat/completions \ -H 'content-type: application/json' \ -H "authorization: Bearer $MAGPIE_KEY" \ -d '{"model":"cloudbase/hy3","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"stream":true}' ``` ## Limitations - **Not real streaming.** The upstream returns one complete JSON body; the plugin synthesizes SSE frames, so time-to-first-token equals full generation time. Short answers feel fine (1–3 s), long ones will not. - **Cloud function timeout.** Default 60 s (`timeout` in `cloudbaserc.json`, max 900 s). Very long outputs get truncated. - **Quota expires.** The growth-plan grant lasts 6 months. After it runs out, change `provider` in the cloud function from `hunyuan-v3` to `cloudbase` to bill against resource points. - **Channel is fixed.** The plugin never calls `/v1/ai/*` directly — that path is blocked for growth-plan quota by design. ## Development ```bash git clone https://github.com/Le0nByte/opencode-cloudbase-auth cd opencode-cloudbase-auth magpie plugin add . magpie plugin login cloudbase magpie provider test cloudbase ``` After editing `index.mjs`, toggle the plugin to reload it: ```bash magpie plugin off opencode-cloudbase-auth magpie plugin on opencode-cloudbase-auth ``` Do **not** restart `magpie.exe` while an agent is using the gateway — the agent's own requests go through `127.0.0.1:3425`. ## License MIT

# opencode-cloudbase-auth Magpie / OpenCode 供应商插件：把腾讯云开发（CloudBase）**小程序成长计划**赠送的模型额度接成 magpie 供应商。 ## 为什么需要它 CloudBase 的 AI 网关对成长计划额度做了通道限制： ``` POST https://{envId}.api.tcloudbasegateway.com/v1/ai/hunyuan-v3/chat/completions → 403 AI_CHANNEL_NOT_ALLOWED 小程序成长计划仅支持小程序 SDK 和云开发 SDK 调用 ``` 只有「小程序 SDK / 云开发 SDK」通道能用这份额度。本插件配合一个云函数（默认名 `aiProxy`）绕开限制： ``` agent → magpie 网关 → 本插件 → CloudBase HTTP API（云函数调用） → 云函数内 @cloudbase/node-sdk（云开发 SDK 通道） → hy3 / hy4 / deepseek-v4.1-flash（扣成长计划额度） ``` 云函数的公网入口只返回一次性 JSON、不支持真流式，所以插件在 `fetch` 里强制 `stream:false` 拿到完整结果，再按客户端原本的意图合成 OpenAI SSE 帧。 ## 数据流 ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph client["客户端"] A["Agent
Hermes / Claude Code / Cursor"] end subgraph magpie["magpie 网关 127.0.0.1:3425"] B["路由到 provider cloudbase"] C["插件 fetch 适配层
强制非流式 + 合成 SSE"] end subgraph cb["腾讯云开发"] D["HTTP API
/v1/functions/aiProxy"] E["云函数 aiProxy
@cloudbase/node-sdk"] F["云开发 SDK 通道
hy3 / hy4 / deepseek-v4.1-flash"] end A -->|"model: cloudbase/hy3"| B --> C C -->|"stream: false"| D --> E --> F F -->|"扣成长计划额度"| E E -->|"完整 JSON"| C C -->|"SSE 帧 + [DONE]"| A ``` 可编辑版本：[`docs/architecture.drawio`](docs/architecture.drawio)（用 [app.diagrams.net](https://app.diagrams.net) 打开）。客户端不支持 mermaid 时看静态版：[`docs/architecture.svg`](docs/architecture.svg)。 ## 云函数（上游） Node.js 运行时，依赖 `@cloudbase/node-sdk`（>= 3.16）： ```js const tcb = require('@cloudbase/node-sdk') let app exports.main = async (event = {}) => { if (!app) app = tcb.init({ env: process.env.TCB_ENV || 'your-env-id', timeout: 120000 }) const ai = app.ai() const provider = event.provider || 'hunyuan-v3' const model = event.model || 'hy3' const messages = event.messages || [{ role: 'user', content: 'hi' }] const r = await ai.createModel(provider).generateText({ model, messages }) const u = r.usage || {} return { id: 'chatcmpl-' + Date.now(), object: 'chat.completion', created: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000), model, choices: [{ index: 0, message: { role: 'assistant', content: r.text }, finish_reason: 'stop' }], usage: { prompt_tokens: u.prompt_tokens || 0, completion_tokens: u.completion_tokens || 0, total_tokens: u.total_tokens || 0 } } } ``` 部署后公网入口是 `https://{envId}.api.tcloudbasegateway.com/v1/functions/aiProxy`。 ## 登录 两种信息一起填： | 字段 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 云开发环境 ID | 例如 `cloudbase-xxxxxxxx`，存在账号的 `metadata.envId` | | CloudBase API Key | 控制台「环境配置 → API Key 配置」创建，服务端密钥，永不过期 | > API Key 是环境最高权限凭据（可绕过数据库所有访问校验），只放在本机 `~/.config/magpie/plugin-auth.json`（权限 600）。 ## 模型 `hy3`、`hy4`、`hy4-preview`、`deepseek-v4.1-flash`、`deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` —— 均为成长计划抵扣范围内的模型。 agent 里用 `cloudbase/hy3` 这样的 id 调用。 ## 已知限制 - **非真流式**：上游一次性返回，插件合成 SSE，所以首字延迟 = 整段生成时间。 - 云函数默认超时 60s（可在 `cloudbaserc.json` 调大到 900s 上限），长输出会被截断。 - 成长计划额度 6 个月到期；到期后要切 `provider=cloudbase` 走资源点计费，改云函数里的 `provider` 字段即可。 ## 开发 ```bash magpie plugin add ./opencode-cloudbase-auth magpie plugin login opencode-cloudbase-auth magpie provider test cloudbase # 真发一次 completion ```
